prompt: The client asks: "Should our factory move to 24-hour operation?" Fact sheet: demand is 20% above capacity; a night shift would add 30% capacity; the night shift would cost $3M a year; the extra sales would add $5M a year in profit; a new plant would cost $40M; the factory was built in 1990. Which is the best recommendation?

options.text: Add a night shift. Demand is 20% above capacity, and a night shift adds 30% capacity for $3M a year while bringing $5M of extra profit, without the $40M cost of a new plant. The main risk is that night-shift quality or staffing falls short, so the next step is to pilot the night shift on one line.
options.feedback: Right. It leads with the answer, backs it with the numbers that matter, and gives a risk and a next step.
